fato_historico: 1936: Rainey Bethea is hanged in Owensboro, Kentucky in the last known public execution in the United States.
energia_do_dia: Today, the cosmos invites you to release heavy burdens from the past, much like a dark chapter fading into history to make room for brighter horizons. It is a good time to focus on justice for your own soul, letting go of old shadows and stepping into your personal power with renewed clarity and vibrant, authentic determination.
frase_do_dia: The sun rises to wash away the echoes of yesterday with golden light.
significado_numero: Represents the star of hope shining through the darkness of night.
conselho: Consider turning the page today and forgiving yourself for past mistakes with grace.
